voiceSource.title: Voice source
voiceSource.description: In Auto mode the app uses the online voice (Edge) when there's internet and falls back to the local voice (Kokoro/Piper) when offline or when Edge fails.

auto.title: Auto (recommended)
auto.hint: Online when possible, local when needed

virtualMic.title: Virtual microphone
virtualMic.installed: Virtual microphone installed. In Discord/Zoom/games, choose CABLE Output as the microphone.
virtualMic.missing: Virtual microphone not detected yet. It comes with the app installer — restart Windows if you just installed it.

largeFont.title: Large fonts
largeFont.hint: Increases text size across the whole interface

experimental.title: Show experimental models
experimental.hint: Shows Bark, Fish Speech, and other items outside the main flow. They remain off the recommended path for end users.

shortcuts.title: Global shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Press any combination from any app. Custom editing is coming in the next version.
shortcuts.focus: Focus the window and the text field

about.title: About VoiceLaunch TTS
about.description: VoiceLaunch TTS is a free and open-source assistive communication tool. It helps anyone who prefers, needs, or chooses to turn text into voice with speed, autonomy, and privacy.
